title: Incorrect use

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Make damaging alterations recognizable so production decisions do not erode a familiar signature.
strategic_value: Specific counterexamples can help Helsinki prevent inconsistent or unreadable reproductions.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section pairs thirteen numbered incorrect logo treatments with explanations covering contrast, distortion, added elements, fills, effects and image quality.
practical_value: Audit a proposed reproduction against the numbered failure types.

content_islands.name: Incorrect specimens
content_islands.spec: Begin with thirteen numbered altered and low-contrast marks, each crossed out.

content_islands.name: Prohibition and key
content_islands.spec: Follow the examples with original-file guidance and numbered explanations of the failures.

ingredient.name: Unaltered framed logo
ingredient.role: Maintain a stable and legible civic signature.
ingredient.application: Use the original high-quality file horizontally, without distortion, filler, extra framing or effects.
ingredient.scope: The thirteen specimens are prohibited-use examples; do not treat them as available styles.

reference_purposes.Application: Numbered examples let a designer diagnose specific logo failures.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The section prohibits alteration, stretching, rotation, filler color, added elements and effects, and requires adequate original-file quality.
